tools_and_repos.name: alibaba/page-agent
tools_and_repos.purpose: Natural-language control layer for web pages using a client-side JavaScript agent.
use_cases: FusionDesk UI testing for owned pages
notes: Only use on websites/apps we own or have permission to control.
Do not use for scraping or automating third-party sites without permission.
Production setup should use NPM and a controlled model endpoint, not the public demo CDN.
Potential fit for FusionDesk Browser Automation connector and Website Factory module.

tools_and_repos.name: ogulcancevik/herdr
tools_and_repos.purpose: Agent multiplexer for running and monitoring multiple AI coding agents from one terminal.
use_cases: Claude Code and Codex process orchestration
Agent pane spawning through local socket API
notes: Useful as a possible process layer below FusionDesk, not a replacement for FusionDesk orchestration.
FusionDesk should remain the executive brain; HERD can become an agent runner service.
Can help keep agents running on a server or Mac while reconnecting from phone via SSH.
AGPL-3.0 license must be reviewed before commercial integration.
